title: SourcesConfig
description: config/newsrooms/<slug>/sources.yaml. Ingestion never schedules a source without terms_checked.

publisher.description: Who publishes it; independence is counted per publisher.

every.description: How often ingestion fetches it; unused for a vouch source.

use.description: vouch: never fetched; it only vouches for its sections when an agent requests a page there (D187). Its `every` is unused.

vouches.description: Further sections of the same publisher it vouches for: a host and its first path segment (`https://claude.com/resources`), D61, D187.

terms_checked.description: Set by a person after reading the source's terms.

pages.description: false: each feed item's own text is the lead and its page is never fetched (terms that allow the feed only).
